text:
mika: Quick thread 1 onboarding UX: walkthrough banner + first-run checklist overlap on narrow view. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/overlap-small.png

alex: Seen this on iPhone SE emulation 50 the banner covers progress and pushes sample cards below fold.

priya: a11y: dismiss icon missing accessible name. Also contrast for the CTA is borderline at 14px.

jon: Proposal: make banner collapsible and sticky as a bottom strip on mobile. When expanded open a modal with samples. Keeps the checklist visible.

sam: Copy tweak: change CTA to `Try a sample project` and helper text `Skip for now 1 try later` as a subdued link.

mika: UX details: show max 3 sample cards, add `Show more` for full list. Collapse checklist by default with progress summary `3 steps` so it feels lighter.

alex: Figma: I'll add 2 variants (inline vs sticky sheet). Will include focus management notes: set focus to sheet header on open, trap focus, and restore focus on close. Also include aria attributes for dialog.

priya: I'll add accessible labels and alt text examples for sample thumbnails. Example alt: "Chat assistant that summarizes support tickets" not just "screenshot".

jon: I'll add a feature flag and telemetry: quickstart_shown, quickstart_dismissed, sample_clicked, sample_created. A/B test sticky vs inline.

ux-bot: Created ticket #5990 "Onboard: mobile banner overlap + sticky-sheet experiment".

mika: Action items: Alex update Figma; Jon add flag + telemetry; Priya update copy; Sam review microcopy. Aim for staged rollout behind flag.

alex: Will push Figma by EOD and include dev notes.

priya: Copy PR will include CTA and accessible labels.

jon: I'll wire telemetry on staging and share dashboards.

mika: Thanks all, closing thread.
